failure_patterns.pattern: round_trip_flight_malformed: A date range (or depart/return pair) was written as ONE search_flights call using return_date= or return_flights=departure_date. This raised a NameError or ValidationError and dropped the second leg. In one case the hotel in the same turn was also dropped.

rejected_edits.content: Two replies are NOT a single filter triple: (a) a flight class / airline / time / price-cap reply gets one load-filter-save triple for EVERY flight key in CACHE, with identical kwargs; (b) a 'Yes' to an offer of hotels near/close to the cached attractions, with hotels and attractions keys both in CACHE, is `h = get_results_from_cache(key=<most refined hotels key>)`, `a = get_results_from_cache(key=<most refined attractions key>)`, `n = search_nearest(hotels=h, attractions=a, groupBy="hotel")`, `save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels", value=n)`, with no filter and no re-save of the attractions entry.
rejected_edits.target: A search_* call is allowed only for a domain with NO key.

rejected_edits.content: - Use only kwargs listed in TOOL CONFIG. search_flights has NO return_date and NO return_flights kwarg: a round trip or any date pair ('X to Y', 'around X ... returning Y') is two separate assigned+saved search_flights calls (see item -2). Never write `return_flights=...`, `return_date=...` or an undefined variable (e.g. a bare `departure_date`) as an argument value. If the user wants 'just the return flight', make only the cities-swapped search with the return date. A date pair still gives hotel check-in/check-out when a hotel was requested. Never use a TOOL CONFIG example city (Dallas, Boston...) the user did not say. Restaurant dietary words are boolean flags, never cuisines: halal -> `has_halal_options=True`, kosher -> `has_kosher_options=True`, vegan -> `has_vegan_options=True`, vegetarian -> `has_vegetarian_options=True`, gluten-free -> `has_gluten_free_options=True`, nut / dairy allergy -> `has_nut_allergy_options=True` / `has_dairy_allergy_options=True`; `cuisine=` only for a real cuisine name ('Persian').
rejected_edits.target: - Use only kwargs listed in TOOL CONFIG. search_flights has NO return_date: a round trip is two search_flights calls.
